info.name: Acme Store API
info.description:
# Acme Store API

The **Acme Store API** powers the Acme web shop and mobile apps: catalog, orders and customers.
All requests go to `{{baseUrl}}` and authenticate with a bearer token in `{{token}}`.

## Endpoints

| Area | Method | Path | Scope |
|------|--------|------|-------|
| Auth | `POST` | `/auth/token` | — |
| Products | `GET` | `/products` | `catalog:read` |
| Products | `PATCH` | `/products/{id}` | `catalog:write` |
| Orders | `POST` | `/orders` | `orders:write` |
| Customers | `GET` | `/customers/{id}` | `customers:read` |

## Authentication

The collection pre-request script exchanges `{{clientId}}` and `{{clientSecret}}` for an access token with
`pm.sendRequest` and signs every request with an HMAC header:

```http
POST /v1/orders HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer <access token>
X-Acme-Timestamp: 1790000000
X-Acme-Signature: 5f2b9c…  (HMAC-SHA256 of method, path and timestamp)
```

## Errors

Errors use [RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457) problem details:

```json
{ "type": "https://docs.acme-store.example/errors/out-of-stock", "status": 409, "title": "Out of stock" }
```

> Rate limit: **600 requests per minute** per client. Watch the `X-RateLimit-Remaining` header.

item.description: OAuth 2.0 client-credentials flow. Tokens are cached per run by the collection pre-request script.

request.description:
Exchanges the client credentials for a **short-lived access token** (OAuth 2.0 client-credentials grant).

- Tokens expire after `expires_in` seconds (default 900).
- The collection pre-request script calls this endpoint for you with `pm.sendRequest`; you rarely need to send it by hand.

Field to sort by; prefix with `-` for descending

request.description:
Returns a **paginated** list of products. Filter by `category`, sort by any numeric field.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
|-----------|------|---------|-------|
| `category` | string | — | `audio`, `wearables`, `home`, `accessories` |
| `sort` | string | `name` | prefix `-` for descending |
| `limit` | integer | `20` | max `100` |

The response carries a `next` cursor while more pages exist.
